title: Etiquette Enderman
description: Endermen ask for consent before being aggroed if you look at them
body:
Endermen ask for consent before being aggroed if you look at them.

Works server-side only. Endermen will ask the target player with a dialog for consent to become aggro.

Also check out [Consent Creepers](https://modrinth.com/project/consent-creepers).
